In this paper, we present InfiniGen, a novel KV cache management framework tailored for long-text generation, which synergistically works [...] overhead from the host memory in offloading-based LLM serving systems. Our evaluation on several representative LLMs shows that InfiniGen improves the overall performance of a modern offloading-based system by up to 3.00x compared to prior KV cache management methods while offering substantially better model accuracy.
